verses.text: Ha Jehová Rey toni, ha t'a yib'anh heb' querubín ayk'e sk'ojnub'. Tz'ib'xi niwak chonhab' yuj xiwelal, tz'ib'xi pax masanil lum lum.
Niwan ton yelk'och Jehová t'a tzalan Sion. A' ay yopisio t'a yib'anh masanil chonhab'.
Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'ay, yujto niwan ton yelk'ochi, te ay smay, Haxonhej Ochi.

Mamin, a ach tik Rey ach toni, masanil syal u'uj, tza xajanej tojolal. Ha ach a b'onakkani to lajannhej tz'aj sch'olb'itaj junjun anima. Ha t'ayonh yinhtilal onh kan winhaj Jacob tik ix ak' tojolal yet' wach'ilal.
Ex wetchonhab', kik'ekcha'anh sb'i Jehová ko Diosal. Konh emek kuman t'a yichanh yujto Haxonhej Ochi.

Ha winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón, ek'nak heb' winh t'a skal heb' sacerdote Dios chi'. Ha winhaj Samuel ek'nak winh t'a skal heb' lesalwinak t'a Jehová. Ix tak'wi t'a heb' ayik ix sk'anan skolwal heb'.
T'a skal jun topanh asun ix lolon Dios yet' heb'. Ha sk'ayb'ub'al yet' scheknab'il ix yak' t'a heb', ix sk'anab'ajej heb'.
Mamin Jehová ko Diosal, ix ach tak'wi t'a a chonhab'. Ix ak' niwank'olal smul heb', palta ix ak' pax syahelal heb' yuj schukal.
Ex wetchonhab', kik'ekcha'anh sb'i Jehová ko Diosal. Konh emek kuman t'a yichanh t'a tzalan yik ejmelal, yujto a Jehová ko Diosal chi' Haxonhej Ochi.
